name: memo-agent
purpose: Keep short memos and find them again. The same shape as the notes reference, renamed; the factory's own tests build it with a fake agent.

fields.name: id
fields.rule: memo_ followed by 10 hex characters, assigned by the store

fields.name: tags
fields.rule: lowercase, from #hashtags or a comma list

actions.name: search_memos
actions.does: Find memos by words or a tag.

actions.name: delete_memo
actions.does: Delete one memo by its exact id.

memory.store: one JSON file in the agent's data directory
memory.retention: until the user deletes a memo

subagent.name: memo_summarizer
subagent.job: Summarize a set of memos in a separate process.
